description: Fused Stage-B episode list for SNav (aug_mix + manual_98). R2R-CE compatible: each episode carries scene_id, start_position, start_rotation and goals[0].position, so the open-source renderers can regenerate the training frames from a local MP3D copy. Instruction text and reference actions are the exact values SNav-7B was trained on.
